name: Fatehpur Sikri
description: Fatehpur Sikri is a red sandstone city in Uttar Pradesh, about 36 km from Agra, built by Emperor Akbar as his Mughal capital from 1571. He had it designed partly to honour a Sufi saint who predicted the birth of his son. Its palaces, courtyards and the vast Jama Masjid still stand, though the court left after only about 14 years.
